The '''1903–04 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Third Lanark A.C.|Third Lanark]] by four points over nearest rival [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]]. The [[Scottish Football League|top division of Scottish football]] expanded from 12 to 14 teams, and [[Airdrieonians F.C. (1878)|Airdrieonians]] and [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]] joined the division having finished first and second in Division Two the [[1902-03 Scottish Division Two|previous season]].
